scope: Correctness fixes and validation-selected teacher retraining; same 11 inputs and LQR plus PPO residual topology. No deployed predictor, memory, extra state or controller branch.
teacher_selection: 40 candidate grid evaluated only on development seeds 31000-31002, scales [0.94,1.03],[1.06,0.97]. Maximize completions then minimize aggregate penalized RMSE. Full search retained.
comparison: All three final training seeds; equally pretrained corrected PPO, BC-only ablations, previous three LANS and PPO seeds, original LQR, original MPC and objective-matched MPC. No per-condition controller or seed selection.
metric: Same 1001-sample initial-inclusive penalized RMSE; all failures and traces retained; steering limit 0.5 rad; 100 Hz full-command FIFO.
freeze: Final policy hashes must be frozen after training and before final evaluation. No final-result-based tuning. These finite-case comparisons cannot prove universal first place or a distinct PPO-learning benefit.
limitations: Nominal teacher cannot observe unknown mass. Four-sample policy preview vs twenty-sample MPC preview. Linear small-angle simulator only. Projected PPO actor update is intentionally small; pretraining may dominate.
